name: relate-example-33-wasm-extract
description: Example 33: edgextract's approach in a browser tab, with GLiNER2.5 (gliner-rs WASM), Relate 1.2.0 WASM and NVL. Install with `npm ci --omit=peer`, then `npm run vendor`.

scripts.vendor: esbuild web/vendor-entry.mjs --bundle --format=esm --minify --legal-comments=external --metafile=web/vendor/nvl.js.meta.json --outfile=web/vendor/nvl.js && esbuild node_modules/@neo4j-nvl/layout-workers/lib/hierarchical-layout/HierarchicalLayout.worker.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --legal-comments=external --metafile=web/vendor/HierarchicalLayout.worker.js.meta.json --outfile=web/vendor/HierarchicalLayout.worker.js && cp node_modules/@neo4j-nvl/base/LICENSE.txt web/vendor/NVL-LICENSE.txt
